verified_bgc_ms2_genome_links.known_link: The sponge Mycale hentscheli is the source of the polyketide Mycalamide A. Since there is a close correlation between the module architecture of a polyketide synthase and the polyketide structure, assumptions about the core BGC are possible if the structure is known and vice versa. The mycalamide biosynthetic gene cluster (myc) was identified in the metagenome of a sponge sample known to contain mycalamide. The module architecture is in good agreement with the mycalamide structure. The assignment of the biosynthetic gene cluster to mycalamide was facilitated by the fact that mycalamide belongs to the pederin-family molecules for which very similar gene clusters were already known.
